title: Ford's Theatre

orientationControl.basis: 10th Street frontage faces west. Current Qualla photographs distinguish the theatre from its lower south/Star Saloon wing. Generalized 33.23 m whole frontage is not the five-bay theatre width.

notes: The mapped envelope includes a 23.23 m theatre rectangle and approximately 10 m lower south frontage with shorter depth. Partition at the mapped rear step is a photographic/map interpretation, not a surveyed party wall. Source model includes both masses and preserves the rear step; it omits other adjoining buildings and interiors. HABS DC-82 side/rear elevations guide sparse service openings and three roof ventilators; current facade follows 2014/2016 local Qualla photos.
limitations: Map vertices are generalized at zoom 15; facade partition and individual heights are medium-fi estimates.
HABS plans document earlier external form; surviving front appearance is checked against Qualla photographs.
Ground contact is reviewed against separately preserved host-terrain samples; no elevation survey is claimed.
geometryLabel: Protomaps ensemble footprint; taller theatre and lower south wing partition
source: Protomaps building and theatre POI 35184524221730; Qualla photographs; Library of Congress HABS DC-82
axis: +X south along 10th Street; +Z west toward 10th Street; +Y up. heading -pi/2 maps these to Earth east/south axes.
identityStatus: Named theatre POI shares the mapped building ID. Footprint is an ensemble envelope, partitioned into the taller five-bay theatre and lower three-bay south wing visible in current photographs.
